outcome: maternal complications (HELLP syndrome, pulmonary edema, cerebral hemorrhage, placental abruption, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 200 pregnant women (>20 weeks gestation) recruited between January-April 2022, with 100 having hypertensive disorders and 100 normotensive controls.
finding: Hypertensive disorders, particularly eclampsia and severe pre-eclampsia, are associated with worse maternal and fetal outcomes.
